importPanel.title: Import
importPanel.importXfdfDesc: Import annotations from an XFDF file into the current document
importPanel.importBcfDesc: Import BCF topics from another BIM tool as annotations
importPanel.importCadDesc: Import a DWG or DXF drawing as a PDF page to scale, with layers and a measuring scale

exportPanel.title: Export
exportPanel.exportImagesDesc: Save pages as PNG or JPEG image files
exportPanel.exportRasterDesc: Flatten pages and annotations into a new PDF with rasterized images
exportPanel.exportXfdfDesc: Export all annotations to an XFDF file for sharing or backup
exportPanel.exportBcfDesc: Export annotations as BCF 2.1 topics for other BIM tools
exportPanel.exportPdfxDesc: Create a print-ready PDF/X file with an output intent and metadata
exportPanel.pdfxNote: Adds an sRGB output intent, TrimBox and PDF/X metadata. Existing RGB images are not converted to CMYK; for strict CMYK printing, substitute a CMYK profile.
exportPanel.exportCadDesc: Export the vector drawing to DXF or DWG, with layers, scale and area
exportPanel.exportOdtDesc: Editable text and tables with optional page images
exportPanel.exportExcelDesc: Recover tables into separate, formatted worksheets
exportPanel.officeNote: Exports PDF text and tables, using existing OCR when needed. Complex layouts may need correction. Save pending text edits first.
exportPanel.officeImages: Include a reference image of each page
exportPanel.officeDecimal: Number format in the source PDF
exportPanel.officeSaveEditsFirst: Save your text edits before exporting to ODT or Excel.
exportPanel.officeNoText: No extractable text. Run OCR on this page before exporting editable text or tables.
